key_highlights: Banks (CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC) led ASX off a three-day losing streak, but home loan applications fell 15% post-budget and mortgage stress hit 18-year highs
Fourth RBA rate hike looms as house prices face potential 10% correction; economy narrowly avoided recession but productivity rated 'bad to worse'
Persian Gulf tanker attacks and Middle East tensions spike oil prices, adding inflationary pressure and AUD upside risk
Mining exploration active: Macarthur clears WA iron ore hurdle, Lindian signs 20-yr Kazakhstan rare earths offtake, Dalaroo/PLC/True North expand gold-copper programmes
Energy transition costs mounting; TMK Energy gas rates surge; Beetaloo flagged as gas cartel counterweight; Chinese solar capacity now exceeds coal
Treasurer Chalmers under pressure on housing affordability; debt war intensifies; regional doctors and childcare sector in distress

sectors.trend: Banks supported ASX index but face structural headwinds: 15% drop in home loan applications, 18-year high mortgage stress, and a looming fourth rate hike that will compress NIMs while raising credit-loss provisions
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX may see near-term index support but medium-term earnings pressure from credit deterioration and rate-cycle peak. Watch NPL trends and provision guidance

sectors.trend: Exploration pipeline strengthening: Macarthur WA iron ore bulk test cleared, Lindian 20-yr rare earths offtake, Dalaroo 12,000m African gold drill, True North Qld copper expansion, PLC WA Murchison gold. Oil climbing on Gulf tensions supports energy miners
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from iron ore demand; small-caps (LIND.AX, DLR.AX, TRN.AX, PLC.AX) offer optionality. Rare earths theme gains strategic relevance amid China supply dynamics

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo positioned against gas cartel; Chinese solar overtakes coal globally; One Nation pushing coal plant retention. Energy transition costs 'running off rails'
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, BGL.AX face policy uncertainty. Gas names (TMK, BGL) see near-term upside. Coal (WDS, LNC) faces structural decline but political support. LNG exporters (BHP, WDS) benefit from oil-linked pricing

sectors.trend: Regional doctors striking over conditions; childcare chain shutting Canberra centres; Ozempic maker in trouble with tablet alternatives emerging. Consumer stress evident in mortgage and housing data
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX offer defensive quality. Healthcare workforce crisis may pressure public system but support private providers. Consumer staples (WES, WOW) benefit from rate-sensitive consumer pullback

sectors.trend: Nvidia confirms AI boom continues; HPE, Ciena beat on AI data centre demand; but community opposition to data centres intensifies in Australia. Dropbox breach highlights cyber risk
sectors.implications: Global AI capex cycle supports ASX-listed data centre and infrastructure plays. Local sentiment risk around data centre siting. Limited direct ASX exposure but indirect via BHP, CSL tech partnerships

sectors.trend: House prices face potential 10% correction; Melbourne councils admit inability to cope with population growth; home loan applications down 15%. Housing affordability crisis deepening
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face rental demand pressure if household stress escalates. Residential property exposure is a key risk. Commercial REITs less affected but rate-sensitive

key_themes: Housing affordability crisis: 15% loan application drop, 18-yr high mortgage stress, 10% price correction risk
RBA rate path: fourth hike looming despite near-recession GDP; productivity 'bad to worse'
Geopolitical oil shock: Persian Gulf tanker attacks, Middle East tensions driving energy prices
AUD/inflation nexus: inflation 'rocket' could push AUD higher, hurting exporters
Mining exploration renaissance: rare earths, gold, copper, iron ore pipeline expanding
Energy transition cost overruns and policy fragmentation
AI infrastructure boom vs. local community resistance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike triggering housing correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce residential REIT and property-linked exposure; favour fixed-income and dividend-paying financials with strong capital buffers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Persian Gulf escalation spiking oil and inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor BHP.AX, WDS.AX as oil beneficiaries; hold AUD as inflation hedge
Favour defensive sectors (healthcare, consumer staples); avoid cyclical exposure until GDP trajectory clarifies

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage stress and credit deterioration in banking sector
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor CBA.AX, NAB.AX provision guidance; consider reducing bank weight if NPLs rise; favour WBC.AX with lower residential exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition policy fragmentation and cost overruns
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify across energy sub-sectors; avoid single-policy-bet positions; watch One Nation political influence on coal
Monitor AUD/USD; if inflation-driven AUD surge persists, reduce mining/energy export exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight oil-linked miners and energy producers on Gulf escalation
opportunities.rationale: Persian Gulf tanker attacks and Middle East tensions driving oil higher; BHP and WDS benefit from commodity price upside

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to rare earths and critical minerals exploration
opportunities.rationale: Lindian 20-yr offtake and expanding exploration pipeline signal structural demand; geopolitical supply-chain diversification tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Rate hike cycle and housing stress favour low-beta, dividend-paying names; CSL and WES offer resilience

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and property-linked exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price correction risk, 15% loan application drop, and 18-yr high mortgage stress create downside for property sector

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim cyclical bank exposure pending rate decision
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth RBA hike will compress NIMs; credit losses rising with mortgage stress; wait for rate-cycle clarity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD appreciation risk in export-heavy portfolios
defensive_moves.rationale: Inflation-driven AUD surge could pressure mining and energy exporter earnings in AUD terms

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1-3 months. Fourth RBA rate hike and housing stress dominate. Banks provide index support but credit concerns cap upside. Oil spike adds volatility. Expect 3-5% downside risk to ^AXJO if rate shock hits housing.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA peaks and housing stabilises. Mining exploration pipeline (rare earths, gold, copper) offers structural upside. AI infrastructure and energy transition remain multi-year themes. Productivity concerns and debt sustainability are medium-term overhangs.
key_catalysts: Persian Gulf / Middle East escalation trajectory
Housing credit data and NPL trends
US Fed policy and global risk sentiment
watch_list: RBA cash rate and statement (next meeting)
Iron ore, oil, gold, LNG spot prices
CBA/NAB home loan application and NPL data
Persian Gulf shipping and oil supply
ASX 200 sector rotation: banks vs. materials vs. defensives
Chinese solar vs. coal capacity data
